Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set – Premium Corporate Gifting Solution

The Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set is a refined blend of technology, functionality, and executive elegance, designed for premium corporate gifting, festive occasions, and brand promotions. Thoughtfully curated, this gift set includes the Shimmer 15W Wireless Charging Multifunctional Clock, a premium Diary, and a sleek Pen, all presented in a sophisticated black finish. Crafted to elevate your brand image, this set delivers everyday utility while making a lasting impression.

At the heart of the set is the Shimmer 15W Wireless Charging Multifunctional Clock, engineered for modern workspaces. It combines fast wireless charging with a digital clock, alarm, and temperature display, offering convenience without clutter. This multifunctional desk accessory supports compatible smartphones and devices, making it ideal for offices, home desks, and executive cabins.

The premium diary included in the Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set is perfect for daily planning, note-taking, and professional meetings. Paired with a smooth-writing pen, the set becomes a complete productivity companion. The elegant black color adds a timeless appeal, ensuring suitability across industries and occasions.

Product Specifications

  • Product Name: Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set
  • Included Items: 15W Wireless Charging Multifunctional Clock, Diary, Pen
  • Color: Black
  • Product Dimensions: 19 x 27 x 8.5 cm
  • Packaging Dimensions: 19 x 27 x 8.5 cm
  • Packaging Weight: 1155 Grams

Key Features & Benefits

  • 15W fast wireless charging for compatible smartphones
  • Multifunctional digital clock with alarm and temperature display
  • Premium-quality diary for professional use
  • Smooth metal pen for effortless writing
  • Elegant black finish suitable for corporate and luxury gifting
  • Light-Up Logos that add a sophisticated, luminous appeal to your brand
  • Compact and well-organized packaging for a premium unboxing experience

One of the standout features of this set is the option for Light-Up Logos. This customization adds a modern, luminous appeal that enhances brand visibility, especially in low-light environments. Light-up branding not only attracts attention but also reinforces your brand’s premium positioning, making this set ideal for high-end corporate gifting and promotional campaigns.

With precise product dimensions of 19 x 27 x 8.5 cm and matching packaging dimensions, the Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set is compact yet impactful. The sturdy packaging ensures safe handling and transportation, while the total packaging weight of 1155 grams reflects the premium materials used in the set.

Ideal Use Cases

  • Corporate gifts for clients, partners, and employees
  • Festive gifting for Diwali, New Year, and special occasions
  • Employee onboarding and appreciation kits
  • Premium promotional giveaways and brand activations
  • Executive desk accessories for offices and home workspaces

Designed to meet modern gifting expectations, the Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set aligns with high search intent keywords such as corporate gift set, wireless charging desk organizer, premium executive gift, customized corporate gifts, and branded tech accessories. Its multifunctional design ensures daily use, keeping your brand visible and relevant over time.

Whether you are looking to impress high-value clients or reward top-performing employees, the Shimmer 15W Wireless Charging Multifunctional Clock combined with a diary and pen delivers unmatched value. The balance of technology and tradition makes this set a versatile choice for businesses seeking meaningful and memorable gifts.

Choose the Shimmer Tech 3 in 1 Gift Set to showcase innovation, professionalism, and attention to detail. With elegant aesthetics, practical features, and customizable light-up logos, this premium gift set helps your brand stand out while offering genuine utility to the recipient.
